title: Release Charge Disclosure — Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing
content:
## How the release charge is calculated

A release ends a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing at the customer's own request once the state order's requirement has ended, and a release notice goes to the ordering state. A release notice is charged the certificate's release filing fee, as scheduled for the certificate held, and the release charge is that fee booked to the cent.

The release charge is the certificate's release filing fee plus the adjusted release clearance charge, the release confirmation-copy charge and the release envelope charge, the sum rounded to the cent, and it is booked once, on the release notice transmission, at 0.00 where the sum is zero.

| Item | Amount |
|---|---|
| Release filing fee | The certificate's release filing fee |
| Release clearance charge | 0.00 |
| Adjusted release clearance charge | The release clearance charge as it stands |
| Release confirmation-copy charge | 0.00 |
| Release envelope charge | 0.00 |
| **Release charge** | Release filing fee, adjusted release clearance charge, confirmation-copy charge and envelope charge added together, rounded to the cent |

## Booking

- The charge is booked once, on the release notice transmission.
- A total of zero is still booked, as 0.00.

## Example (hypothetical figures)

With a release filing fee of 0.00 and every other line at 0.00, the release charge is 0.00, booked at 0.00 on the release notice transmission. With a release filing fee taken, for illustration only, as 4.00, the release charge would be 4.00.
